title: kbsettings.layered(root, "gate_checks") raises key gate_checks must be an object for the list SURFACE and the docs give it
goal: kbsettings.layered(root, 'gate_checks') returns the merged list of argument lists over the settings layers, as kbext.SURFACE and kb/_self/extending.md describe the key (list of argument lists), instead of raising SettingsError 'key gate_checks must be an object'; ST-vsdhy56r reads the layers' files with layer_files meanwhile

run: import json,sys,tempfile,pathlib; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kbsettings; d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); (d/'settings.json').write_text(json.dumps({'gate_checks':[['true']]})); kbsettings.layered(d,'gate_checks')
